info.title: API.SH: Spotify
info.description: The Spotify API from API.SH: public Spotify data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An album with its tracks (50 per page; pass `next_offset` back as `offset`): label, copyright, release date, discs, artists, cover, play counts and more albums by the artist. With `market` (country code) it adds `market`: each track of the page as offered in that country (playable or not, restriction, relinked track, popularity, ISRC) and the playable count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-album

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, JP, BR): adds `market` with each track's playability, restriction, relinking, popularity and ISRC in that country.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for names where Spotify has translations (e.g. de, ja, es_MX).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An artist: followers, monthly listeners, world rank, top cities, biography, gallery, top tracks, latest release, albums, singles, compilations, playlists, related artists, concerts and merch. With `market` (country code) it adds `market.top_tracks`: the artist's top tracks in that country with popularity and playability.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-artist

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, JP, BR): adds the artist's top tracks in that country (`market.top_tracks`).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for names where Spotify has translations (e.g. de, ja, es_MX).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Releases by other artists that an artist appears on (the latest 50 Spotify lists on the artist's "Appears on" page, with the total): release id, name, type, date, cover and its main artists. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-artist-appears-on

get.description:
Spotify's official charts. Songs: daily (Top 50) or weekly (Top Songs) for 70+ countries and global, each entry with rank, previous rank, movement and the track fields of /spotify/v1/track. Artists and albums: the global weekly top 50 (other countries and periods need a Spotify login). Pass `next_offset` back as `offset` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-charts

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (UK works for GB) or global (default); a country name such as Germany also works. Some countries have only a weekly chart.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Value of `next_offset` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search tracks, artists, albums, playlists, podcasts and episodes (type=all also top results, audiobooks, users and genres). 10 per section for type=all, 50 for one type; pass `next_offset` back as `offset`. With `market` or `locale` the search runs for that country and language: results available there, each with playability, popularity and ISRC for tracks (type=all then returns tracks, artists, albums, playlists, podcasts, episodes and audiobooks).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: tracks, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts or episodes.

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, JP, BR): search what is available in that country.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language for results (e.g. de, ja, es_MX).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The top results Spotify's search box shows while typing: artists, tracks, albums, playlists, podcasts and suggested searches, each with type, name, id, link and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-search-suggest

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A track: title, artists, album (with label, copyright, release date, cover), duration, play count, explicit flag, playability, lyrics availability and visual identity. With `market` (country code) it adds `market`: whether the track plays in that country, the restriction reason, the track it is relinked from, popularity, ISRC and preview link.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-track

parameters.name: market
parameters.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. DE, JP, BR): adds `market` with playability, restriction, relinking, popularity and ISRC for that country.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The credits Spotify shows for a track: performers, writers, producers and every other credited role, each with name, Spotify artist or songwriter link, image and sub-roles, plus the credit sources (labels). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-track-credits

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public Spotify user profile: display name, image, follower and following counts, number of public playlists, the first 10 public playlists (name, followers, image) and recently played artists when the user shares them. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-user

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The followers Spotify lists on a public profile (a subset for large accounts): name, profile link, image and follower count. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-user-followers

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Value of `next_offset` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: Spotify lists a subset of a profile's followers (most followed first for large accounts); the follower total is on /spotify/v1/user.

get.description:
A user's public playlists: id, name, image, follower count and owner. Playlists not available in the market are left out, so a page can be shorter than `limit`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset` (null on the last page). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/spotify-user-playlists

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Value of `next_offset` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
